{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Drop QA orders and refunded orders, and convert revenue
sales_clean = sales[~(sales['revenue'] == '999,999.99')]
sales_final = sales_clean[sales_clean['status'] == 'completed']
sales_final['revenue'] = sales_final['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check the distribution of channels and customer segments
print("Channel distribution:", sales_final['channel'].value_counts().to_dict())
print("Customer segment distribution:", sales_final['customer_segment'].value_counts().to_dict())

# Check if channel and customer_segment are confounded
print("Cross-tabulation of channel vs customer_segment:")
cross_tab = pd.crosstab(sales_final['channel'], sales_final['customer_segment'])
print(cross_tab)

# Compute conversion rate by channel
conversion_by_channel = sales_final.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean().round(4)
print("Conversion rate by channel:", conversion_by_channel.to_dict())

# Compute average revenue by channel
avg_revenue_by_channel = sales_final.groupby('channel')['revenue'].mean().round(2)
print("Average revenue by channel:", avg_revenue_by_channel.to_dict())"}
